items.claim: Color field with alpha held apart still marks a half "moved" after a canceled drag
A nested `pack="pairs"` group's rows don't pair, because the parent group's packing rules reach into it
items.note: The pack class moved onto the group's body, so the rules use child combinators.

items.claim: Disabled inline paint control drops its `disabledReason`
DialogRow's button name leaves out the summary it shows
items.note: The summary is now the button's description; the name stays "Edit …".

items.claim: CurveField's flips and reset skip the snap and clamp that drags get
CurveField plot has no accessible name and no way to give it one
items.note: Adds a new `aria-label` prop, so its changeset is `minor`. Without it, the row's label names the plot and a group around the plot and buttons.

items.claim: Font family and weight controls ignore `unset`
Standalone slider disabled with a reason has no tab stop, and its readout drops the reason
Font family and weight controls drop their `id`
Disabled inline paint editor remounts whenever `disabled` flips
Menu enum button's name loses the chosen value when its label is not text
